description: No ?url or ?article projected: scan variables in projection order and pick the first whose binding in the FIRST result row contains the project domain. ?item (a Wikidata URI) does not match; ?page does. Non-matching rows are then dropped and counted.

provenance.derived: Assembled from rows of the mixed-domain capture (Q9202 sitelinks) and the article-variable capture; reordered so an en.wikipedia.org row is first. Query text is illustrative.
